dev-top.sql: SELECT repo, stars FROM repositories ORDER BY stars DESC, repo ASC LIMIT 3

dev-null.sql: SELECT repo FROM repositories WHERE license IS NULL ORDER BY repo

dev-zero.sql: SELECT repo, forks FROM repositories WHERE stars = 0 ORDER BY repo

dev-owner-totals.sql: SELECT owner, COUNT(*) AS repository_count, SUM(stars) AS total_stars FROM repositories GROUP BY owner ORDER BY owner

dev-average.sql: SELECT repo, stars FROM repositories WHERE stars > (SELECT AVG(stars) FROM repositories) ORDER BY stars DESC, repo ASC

dev-quotes.sql: SELECT repo, description FROM repositories WHERE description LIKE '%''%' ORDER BY repo

dev-missing-owner.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repositories WHERE owner = 'delta'

dev-tied-winners.sql: SELECT r.owner, r.repo, r.stars FROM repositories r JOIN (SELECT owner, MAX(stars) AS max_stars FROM repositories GROUP BY owner) m ON r.owner = m.owner AND r.stars = m.max_stars ORDER BY r.owner, r.repo

dev-license-groups.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN license IS NULL THEN 'unlicensed' ELSE license END AS license_label, COUNT(*) AS repository_count FROM repositories GROUP BY license_label ORDER BY license_label

dev-share.sql: SELECT repo, ROUND(100.0 * stars / (SELECT SUM(stars) FROM repositories), 2) AS percentage FROM repositories ORDER BY repo
